answer_1.quote: We systematically explore diverse strategies beyond the conventional pipeline for developing instruction-tuned models for low-resource languages, seeking to identify optimal adaptation paths for Basque as our primary case study

answer_2.quote: We selected benchmarks that are close to real use cases, from a varied range of categories: reading comprehension, common sense, linguistic proficiency, knowledge and maths & reasoning

answer_4.quote: we conducted human evaluations through A/B testing (arena style) to capture qualitative aspects of model performance
answer_4.guideline: participants evaluated pairs of model responses by making a three-way choice (i.e., prefer model 'A', prefer model 'B', or consider them tied) across two dimensions: content quality and linguistic quality
